biotools.summary: DPPPredIV is a web server for predicting dipeptidyl peptidase 4 (DPP4) inhibitors, developed by ProtoQSAR. It integrates binary classification and continuous regression QSAR models and is freely available within the ChemoPredictionSuite to accelerate drug discovery efforts.
